ns2:section.sectionText: Computational Methods for Systems Engineering This course introduces computational methods for the design and analysis of complex aerospace systems and system-of-systems. We specifically focus on techniques to support operational analysis and conceptual design of such systems, by introducing data-drive methods to model system operations and optimization methods for system design. Topics include linear regression, classification, neural networks, Design of Experiments, surrogate modeling, and multi-objective optimization. Pre-requisites: IE 300 or equivalent statistical analysis course (or permission of the instructor) Undergraduates Register for 3 hours Graduates Register for 4 hours
